IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Saturday, August 1, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is firing on all cylinders with 93 hands needed across Prime Controls, Quality Electric, and Lea Electric on the Micron ID1 fab—that's **$45.33/hr + $20/hr incentive** plus **$170/day per diem x7** if you qualify. PLA job, start dates TBD after background, but this is the type of long-haul money that's worth the relocate. Top scale sits at $65.33.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 98 Inside JW calls—nearly half the board—chasing Polaris Forge Data Center out in Harwood. Parsons Electric's running dual crews at **$44.80/hr + $100/day per diem** (non-taxed, GPS 100+ miles) on **6-10s with $100 incentive weekdays, $150 Sat/Sun**. Hunt Electric's got 10 more on Grand Forks Air Base at the same rate, 4-10s with Friday OT.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** shows 38 calls across four contractors all hammering Port Washington Data Center: Gurtz, Pieper, MJ, and Cupertino Electric are stacking **JW wage + $10/hr premium** on **60-hour weeks**. Drug test required across the board.

**LU-405 Cedar Rapids, IA** has 33 calls split between EWD and QTS Data Centers—CST alone needs 48 hands running **6-10s starting 7 AM, all OT double time, + $10 over scale**. OSHA 10/30 and background check required.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** stays steady at 47 calls with Inglett & Stubbs leading on Wellstar Paulding and QTS Fayette projects, all **$40–$40.90/hr** on **4-10s + weekend splits**, starting 6 AM.

Data center and advanced manufacturing are pulling hands north and midwest—the PLA work in Boise and the mega-fab sprawl in the Upper Midwest are the money movers right now.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Saturday, August 1, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is running hot with 23 calls and **$45.33/hr** Inside JW work at Micron's Idaho fab — that's **$170/day non-taxed per diem** if you clear the PLA paperwork. Prime Controls and Quality Electric are both feeding bodies into the same massive semiconductor build. The Materials Handler role pays less but moves fast if you need immediate dispatch.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 98 total hands chasing 50-call Polaris Data Center jobs at **$44.80/hr** base, but hit the weekend bonus hard — **$150/day Saturday-Sunday** on top of **$100/day Mon-Fri incentive pay**. Parsons is stacking 100+ bodies on a 6-10 grind. Hunt Electric's Air Base work offers the ND license bump (**+$100/day**) if you hold it, plus legitimate 4-10 schedules with Friday OT built in.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** sits clean with **$55.00/hr** from Summit Line and Cupertino Electric — all OT double time, no games. You need New Mexico JIW License EE98J to walk the gate, but the math works: that's **$110/hr OT on a full-scale inside job**. Rosendin's running lower at **$40 + $15 incentive** if you lock 90% of 60-hour weeks.

**LU-586 Ottawa, Canada, ON** is a wildcard: Modern Niagara wants **90 Inside JW** at the Petawawa base, but you're submitting Secret clearance **three months ahead**. Canadian rates don't translate cleanly in USD, but the volume is real and the work is stable military/infrastructure.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** has New River Electric fielding **40 Journeyman Lineman** on distribution work — 6-10s, **$125/night per diem**, and a **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**. That's pure gravy if you're hungry for 60-hour weeks.

**Market read:** Data centers and semiconductor fabs are absolutely consuming labor right now — Polaris, Micron, and Petawawa are pulling from multiple locals simultaneously. Distro work in the Midwest and Southeast remains steady but doesn't pay near the fab premium.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Saturday, August 1, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running hot with 18 calls and 61 hands needed—the fattest board this week. BCS Mechanical owns the Sego Project in West Valley with dual calls: 15 JW Pipefitters and 13 JW Plumbers, both locked into 4-10s starting August 3. DSI's QTS data center play in Eagle Mountain is tighter but sharper—6 JW Pipefitters at **$10.00/hr premium** on a 5-8 schedule with rotating 5-10s and 1-8 weekend. Apprentices welcome on the main job. This is where the volume is.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits at 16 calls with 37 hands—heavy specialty work. Kiewit's Fort St. Vrain Powerhouse is running nights 5-10s, 5pm–3am with **$65 per diem** and 15% shift differential; fitters with stainless experience move first. Murphy's Corden Pharma gig in Boulder is tight (2 slots) but hits **$125 per diem** for combo welders on second shift. US Eng. has fab shop and high-purity tube-bending work spreading across metro Denver. Nights dominate here.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** shows 21 calls but lean specifics—the board's biggest red flag. Charter and Apollo are running Intel orbital welder and BIM detailer tickets at Ronler Acres, but scale data vanished. PermaCold's commercial refrigeration service work and Harder's detailer roles fill gaps, but this local needs intel before you pack the truck.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** keeps 10 calls live across refineries and fab shops. Nutrien Shutdown runs 7-12s dayshift with **$150 per diem** for pipefitters 50+ miles out—current DISA required. Bmwc's combo welder fab work adds **$11/hr incentive** on 6-10s. Gem's fab shop tests on the fly; Graham's Cenovus maintenance is spotty OT at 6am. Heavy industrial, serious certifications.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** punches above its 3-call weight. MAP's Holly Frontier Sinclair Refinery shutdown is dayshift welder-only—DISA pass mandatory. PMI doubles down with Ellsworth AFB (combo welders, **$100 per diem**) and Fort Meade VA Hospital plumber work (same rate). All backgrounds required; OSHA 10 locks the door or opens it.

Data center and refinery shutdowns are vacuuming hands west and south—specialty certifications (DISA, OSHA 10, stainless/tube bending) now separate callouts from standouts.
